Please build a customer-facing version of the Pollo Campero DMB pricing matrix for the RFP, with all pricing left blank for now (values TBD, not $0 — nothing has been approved yet).

Keep it to just the clean customer table — leave out internal-only content (Pricing Inputs formulas, Worldpay adoption discount scenarios/column, RFP Decisions notes, open clarifications). Per our RFP Decisions notes: include the customer matrix, keep discount scenarios internal until approved.

Structure — 4 pricing options, each with these columns:
Pricing Structure | Best Fit | Site Count | Indoor Screens | DT Screens | Controllers | Display/Controller One-Time | Survey One-Time | Install Allowance | White Glove One-Time | Subtotal One-Time | CMS Monthly

Options:
1. Controller swap only — Existing screens are viable; swap controller/player layer only.
2. Single lane stores — Indoor menu plus one drive-thru lane.
3. Dual lane stores — Indoor menu plus two drive-thru lanes.
4. Indoor only — Indoor menuboards only; no drive-thru scope.

Leave every pricing/quantity cell blank/TBD across all four options. Save this as a customer-facing artifact on the Pollo Campero account so it's ready to send as soon as pricing is approved.
